profile.headline: Software Engineer | M.S. in Computer Science
profile.summary:
At CACI International Inc, my role as a Software Engineer merges full stack development with cybersecurity, ensuring robust and secure applications for our government client. Mastering technologies like Angular, Spring Boot, and AWS, I tailor solutions that streamline resource coordination and scheduling in a Linux environment. My previous tenure at Forcepoint as a Cyber Security Engineer allowed me to lead the deployment and integration of security products, enhancing customer systems' defenses.

Our team's dedication to implementing cutting-edge security measures and seamless application functionality reflects my commitment to excellence. With expertise in Maven, Gradle, and Python, I contribute to a collaborative effort that aligns with CACI's mission of safeguarding information and optimizing software performance. My approach is driven by a passion for innovation and the goal of achieving the highest standards in the intersection of software engineering and cybersecurity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Working as a full stack developer for a government client.
-Technologies include Angular, Spring Boot, Postgres, AWS in a Linux environment.
-Incorporate unique client requirements into an application designed to document, coordinate and schedule resources for job-related tasks.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring MVC · Gradle · Spring Security · Spring Framework · Maven · Docker Products · Python (Programming Language) · Spring Boot · Java · REST APIs · JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Cyber Security Engineer
positions.description:
- Led installation, configuration, integration and training of commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) cyber products.
- Provide training, troubleshooting, and on-site/remote support to multiple customers.
- Provide engineering leadership on small to medium size teams, coordinating with management and other disciplines to ensure a coordinated and cohesive security engineering effort.
- Prepare documentation to support Assessment and Authorization (A&A) activities.

positions.title: Cyber Security Engineer
positions.description: •	Worked as a cyber security engineer in support of IC agency to support and implement their end point security enterprise-wide program (physical and cloud-based). Offer sound cyber security engineering solutions to existing applications (Tanium, McAfee) that support end point security to all networks in the enterprise.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Support for government agency in their Cyber security mission by developing software applications and tools.
•	Develop software within a cloud environment, while working with an Agile project team. Implement software functionality according to user requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked as a software engineer developing and enhancing applications in a demanding data-driven environment. Technologies used include Java, Java Script, AngularJS SQL and PHP.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Develop and maintain web-based applications for a Government client. Technologies include PHP, JavaScript, SQL, Subvesion/Git.

positions.title: Web Developer - Senior Consultant
positions.description: Web development for a government client. Technologies include: JQuery, PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript and SQL.

positions.title: Information Systems Technician
positions.description:
Member of a technical support team for NIPRNET/SIPRNET Navy and Marine Corps Internet (NMCI) clients. Duties included troubleshooting connectivity and application issues, installation of internal computer components, routine maintenance and supply of network printers. Also responsible of keeping a current inventory of all computer assets. Our group supports around 150 personnel including 3 senior executives.

Responsible for setting up and troubleshooting IP-based VTCs and SVTCs.  Coordination of high-profile audio/video teleconferences sessions, requiring complex system alignments with multiple bridges.

Worked as Assistant Computer Terminal Representative (ACTR); responsible for inventory and maintenance of NMCI seats, accounts, and peripherals.

positions.title: Network Administrator /Information Security Officer
positions.description:
Webmaster responsible for maintaining an external (unclassified) website and for the implementation of the ship’s intranet (Unclassified/Classified) using HTML/CSS, JavaScript and server-side scripts. This intranet was implemented completely from the ground up with the input of the leadership and crew. This included the support for other applications that were used by some departments through the intranet. Graphics and design were original and specifically for the website.

As Information Security Officer, acknowledged and completed Information Assurance Vulnerability Alerts (IAVA), bulletins and technical advisories, network security patches, anti-virus updates, Computer Tasking Orders (CTO) and network computer scans using RETINA software

Monitored all the shipboard networks (Unclassified, Secret, and Top Secret) responded to issues, troubleshoot, and resolution to associated network problems.

Performed system administration duties for all information systems aboard USS MAHAN including Naval Tactical Command Support System (NTCSS), Global Command and Control System (GCCS), Navy Information/Application Product Suite (NIAPS) and Automated Digital Networking System (ADNS).

Responsible for all routers (Cisco) and switches aboard. Performed configuration changes and setup as well as routine maintenance. Setup routers and modems for in port and underway usage. Monitor router usage and bandwidth quotas through ADNS.

positions.title: Information Systems Technician / Webmaster
positions.locationName: USS Dwight D. Eisenhower (CVN69) Norfolk, Virginia Area
positions.description:
As webmaster, responsible for designing and implementing an external (unclassified) website and an intranet (unclassified). Duties also included monitoring the command e-mail account and answer inquiries as requested.

Website was completely designed using HTML (DHTML) with CSS-driven menus and JavaScript. Graphics were all original to the website and developed using Photoshop and Illustrator.
